content.text: Reading fix versions works. Writing one does not, and the version objects lose everything except their name.

- Read is fine: `search --jql 'fixVersion = "v2.5"'` applies with no unsupported clauses; fix_versions is filled on 5178 of 7163 live issues and 283 of 534 demo issues; RECIPES.md already has the json_each query.

- Write is missing from the CLI: `gadak edit --help` has no version flag. The REST layer can already do it — PATCH <key>/fields/ writes fix_versions (internal/server/write_test.go:430-433) and the web maps it as version_array (IssueFields.svelte:104-108). CLI and MCP have nothing.

- The catalog is flattened: internal/sync/sync.go:715 keeps names only, so released, releaseDate, startDate and archived never reach the mirror. "What is in the unreleased train" and "what shipped this week" cannot be asked at all.

- issuetap UpdateIssue has no fixVersions case; unknown system keys land in the Custom map and render.go overlays Custom on top of the typed arrays, so a PUT can be accepted (204) and the typed field and JQL stay stale.

Fix shape: gadak edit KEY --fix-version +id-or-name / -id-or-name, following the id-or-name rule --priority already uses; optionally a versions table (id, name, project_key, released, release_date, archived) filled from GET /rest/api/3/project/{key}/versions — keyed on version id, because joining by name breaks on renamed or localized versions. If this ships, issuetap must set the typed FixVersions rather than overlaying Custom.
Gate: the unknown-flag failure is the FAIL-first; after, the fake sees fields.fixVersions with the resolved id, and SELECT name FROM versions WHERE released = 0 matches the fixture.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track A, score 8/10).
